Create a NEW rank-1 starting illustration for a growing-world iPhone lofi app, tall portrait approximately 9:19.5, edge-to-edge.
Input image is ONLY a STYLE REFERENCE: match its subdued atmospheric pixel-painted illustration, visible irregular pixel clusters, softly broken stepped contours, deep indigo/blue-violet night shadows and amber reflected lamplight. Do NOT copy rooftop/city composition or human. Do NOT use former apothecary pictures.
EXACT USER SCENE: A normal QUADRUPED BLACK CAT on a narrow Japanese stone-paved alley at night, PLAYING WITH A PESTLE THAT IS RESTING INSIDE A MORTAR. This is a close ZOOMED-IN view of the little event, not a panoramic town. Cat has normal realistic feline anatomy, horizontal body, four paws/legs, tail, natural cat proportions; no clothing, apron, biped stance, human arms/hands or mascot design.
Cat is on the GROUND, lightly crouched with hind paws and one forepaw supporting body, ONE front paw gently batting the exposed upper handle of a short stone pestle leaning diagonally INSIDE a small heavy ceramic mortar. Pestle's lower grinding end remains clearly nested inside bowl, handle extends above rim within easy reach. It is play, not purposeful human grinding: paw pads touching side of handle, no fingers gripping, curious head tilted slightly down. Mortar sits firmly on stone pavement directly in front of cat, no floating objects or impossible contact. Cat not sitting on desk or human chair.
COMPOSITION: intimate ground-level three-quarter view with a slight downward angle so bowl opening and paw contact can be seen. Cat and mortar form the clear central-lower focal group, together span roughly 55-65% image width; full cat incl tail visible and approximately 25-30% full image height, larger than previous distant characters because user explicitly asks zoom. Cat is slightly left of center, mortar beside front paws toward center. Uneven worn stone pavers in foreground, a nearby weathered plaster wall and wooden house base, drain gutter, a couple of understated weeds, a simple warm pool of light from an off-frame ordinary home window. Upper portion shows only a short receding slice of the intimate alley with soft dim blue shadows and one warm doorway glimpse, no wide city or distant harbor panorama. The modest mortar is the ONLY pharmaceutical object, perhaps a couple ordinary tiny dried leaf fragments inside, not sparkles or piles of medicine. No workbench, shelves, bottles, still, machines, glowing potions or built-out pharmacy.
CHARACTER TREATMENT CRITICAL: black cat is integrated into background light and pixel texture, soft silhouette with patches disappearing into deep blue shadows, selective amber light on ear/forepaw/back. Eye only a restrained tiny dim amber pixel if visible, no prominent cartoon eyes, no crisp all-around outline, no detailed whisker ink lines, no plush chibi head or sharp mascot. Relaxed curious natural animal, not posing for viewer. Same material rendering and pixel density as scenery.
Quiet intimate chill lofi mood, humble beginning with room for later real transformations. No text, UI, status bar, labels, borders, watermark, human or other animals. One single full portrait STILL concept, no motion trails, arrows, panels or sprite sheet.
